context: Tests whether the agent walks the full 4-signal resolution cascade, falls through to base-inferred-from-labels when all four fail, correctly identifies the base from inherited image labels, and refuses to invent a source URL.

checklist.name: audit-entry.json produced
checklist.description: Working directory contains a file named audit-entry.json that parses as valid JSON.

checklist.name: Resolution signal recorded
checklist.description: The resolution_signal field is base-inferred-from-labels (or a clearly-equivalent value). It is NOT silently filled with chart-sources, slug-heuristic, or oci-label — none of which actually resolved.

checklist.name: Signals tried list complete
checklist.description: The signals_tried list records all four prior probes (local, chart-sources, slug-heuristic, oci-label) with their failure outcomes — proving the cascade was walked in order rather than skipped to the fallback directly.

checklist.name: Base identified from labels
checklist.description: base_inferred is set to rockylinux:9-minimal (or rockylinux 9-minimal / equivalent), derived from the name + version labels in crane-config.json.

checklist.name: OS classification correct
checklist.description: base_os_family is rhel-family (or rhel_family / RHEL-family) and base_os_version is 9. Rocky Linux is correctly recognised as a RHEL-family distribution.

checklist.name: No fabricated source URL
checklist.description: The output does NOT claim to have cloned or read a Dockerfile from a hallucinated source URL. It correctly records that no Dockerfile was available.

checklist.name: No false-positive label use
checklist.description: The agent uses the BASE-image labels (name=rockylinux, version=9-minimal) — NOT the org.opencontainers.image.url label which points at rocky-linux/rocky-toolbox-images (the base's source repo, not the fdb-monitor's).
